decision.detail: I zip the camera bag shut. The reel is in there, flat against my hip, the only heavy thing I'm carrying tonight. I don't go to the patch. I don't go to the ballroom. I walk to the lobby door, press the button, and step out into the February air. The festival lights are still on up on the hill, doing their slow color cycle for no one in particular. I don't look at them twice.
decision.intention: Get home. Put the reel on the shelf by the kitchen window. Eat whatever's in the fridge. Sleep. The line to Pittsburgh can wait until I'm not standing in a lobby. Rita has her booth and her three minutes. Phil has his payphone and his tomorrow. I have my one take and it's mine and it's done.
decision.words: Rita. Got my take. Reel's in the bag. I'm out. Don't wait up either.
